name: Serious Sam Classic for iPhone
subtitle: Sam FE and Sam SE: the classic Serious Sam games on iPhone, with touch controls.
description: Unofficial iPhone builds of Serious Sam: The First Encounter and The Second Encounter, on Croteam's open-source Serious Engine 1 (by way of tx00100xt's SeriousSamClassic), with touch controls. Bring your own game files.

apps.name: Sam FE
apps.subtitle: The First Encounter on iPhone, with touch controls.
apps.localizedDescription:
Serious Sam: The First Encounter on your iPhone, on Croteam's open-source Serious Engine 1.

What makes it fun:
- Touch controls made for Serious Sam: a move stick where your left thumb lands, drag anywhere to look, FIRE, JUMP, USE and CROUCH, and a look speed you can set.
- A weapon wheel: slide off NEXT WPN or PREV WPN and every weapon you carry is round your thumb.
- CAMERA: photos, bursts, selfies with up to 48 enemies posing round Sam, Action Freeze (stop the fight and fly the camera round it) and a cinematic burst. Photos go to your Photos app.
- A cheat for relaxed play (sithewok): god mode, endless ammo, flying, walking through walls and a list of every level.
- Tilt aiming, 60 or 120 frames a second, quick save and load on a short hold, and a HUD that fits notched screens.
- Network games with friends on the same Wi-Fi (little tested so far).

You need your own PC copy of the game: no game files are included. After installing, open the app once, then copy the game's files into Files > On My iPhone > Sam FE. Full guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/releases/latest

It's an unofficial beta: expect bugs, and please report them at https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/issues

Built on tx00100xt's SeriousSamClassic (https://github.com/tx00100xt/SeriousSamClassic). Unofficial, not affiliated with Croteam or Devolver Digital. Free software under the GNU GPL v2.

versions.localizedDescription:
Test build 40 (Nov 9), what will become ios-v0.4: drawing through ANGLE on Metal, a 60/120 FPS switch (hold the tray's FPS), LOOK speed, the cheat's LEVEL list, sound with the phone on silent, and a fix for players who join someone else's game. Not yet tried on an iPhone.

Full notes: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/blob/ios/ios/RELEASE_NOTES.md
ios-v0.3: CAMERA (photos, selfies, bursts, Action Freeze, cinematic burst), network games, typing in the menus, and the sithewok cheat with a level picker.

privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Turning the device aims, while tilt aiming is on (hold MENU to set it).
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CAMERA saves your photos and selfies of the game to your photo library.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Multiplayer finds, hosts and joins games on your Wi-Fi.
